# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# fields: COMMAND_RPC_CREATE_ADDRESS::response_t,
#         src/wallet/wallet_rpc_server_commands_defs.h:224-237
#         { address string, address_index u32, addresses[] vector<string>,
#           address_indices[] vector<u32> }
#         NO status/untrusted.
# request: { account_index u32, count u32 (OPT 1, :218), label string } (:210-221).
# `address`/`address_index` ARE THE SINGULAR FORM AND addresses[]/address_indices[] THE PLURAL, both
#         always present. With count 1 -- fmonero never sends more -- the singular equals the first
#         element of each list. §5c's `wallet new-address` payload shares the `wallet address` key set
#         (primary, addresses[], selected), so fmonero re-reads get_address after this call rather
#         than rendering these four keys directly.
# addresses[] HERE ARE THE NEWLY CREATED ONES ONLY, not the account's whole set -- unlike
#         get_address.json's addresses[], which is every generated subaddress. A consumer that treats
#         this list as the full set loses every earlier subaddress.
# THE ADDRESS is a real, checksum-valid mainnet SUBADDRESS (prefix 42, 95 characters, leading '8')
#         from upstream's own test suite -- tests/unit_tests/base58.cpp:470 is a mainnet STANDARD
#         address, so it is not used here; this one is the donate@getmonero.org subaddress that
#         src/simplewallet/simplewallet.h:56 carries as a literal and that
#         tests/functional_tests/validate_address.py:97-107 asserts is mainnet and `subaddress`.
#         address_index 3 continues get_address.json's 0, 1, 2 -- so create-then-list reads as a
#         coherent story even though the mock is stateless and get_address.json still returns three.
# NOT IN DESIGN.md §8's deliverable list; added by Phase 0 with its reason recorded in
# decisions/phase0-mock.md and tests/fixtures/README.md ("Additions"). The reason: `wallet
# new-address` is an AMBER row in §4b, §5c fixes its payload, and §7a binds `a` on the TUI's Wallet
# screen to it.
